blocks.runs: The 2014 competition will take place on Saturday 25th October at St Mary-le-Bow, by kind permission of the rector, The Rev George Bush and steeple keeper, Simon Meyer. The chief judge is David Dearnley, assisted by Jennifer Town and David House.

The draw will take place at 10:45, and photographs of the bands will be taken immediately afterwards. The first band will ring at 11:30. Ringing will finish at 15:10, with results in the church at around 16:30.
The pub for the day is the Fine Line, on Bow Churchyard. Bacon butties will be on sale from 10am, and the pub is opening especially for us.

blocks.intro: The test piece is 257 Stedman Cinques:
rows: Round at second handstroke with a bob at one.

blocks.runs: The bands taking part in this year's competition are:

items: Ancient Society of College Youths (2 bands)
Middlesex County Association and London Diocesan Guild
University of London Society of Change Ringers
